name: Mikage Sumi
source: Sumi is Jun’s kouhai and also the drummer of the opposing brass band before she moved to Jun’s band (due to bullying). She’s a very quiet girl who finds it hard to stand up for herself. She relies on her best friend - an energetic girl named Kyoko - quite a lot.
